WITH numerator AS (SELECT orders.currency AS dimension_0, SUM(refunds.amount) AS measure_value FROM refunds INNER JOIN orders ON refunds.order_id = orders.id WHERE orders.status = 'completed' GROUP BY orders.currency ORDER BY dimension_0), denominator AS (SELECT orders.currency AS dimension_0, SUM(orders.total_amount) AS measure_value FROM orders WHERE orders.status = 'completed' GROUP BY orders.currency ORDER BY dimension_0) SELECT COALESCE(numerator.dimension_0, denominator.dimension_0) AS dimension_0, CASE WHEN COALESCE(denominator.measure_value, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(numerator.measure_value, 0) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(COALESCE(denominator.measure_value, 0) AS DECIMAL) * 100 END AS metric_value FROM numerator FULL OUTER JOIN denominator ON numerator.dimension_0 = denominator.dimension_0 ORDER BY dimension_0
SELECT o.order_number, CASE WHEN o.total_amount >= 300 THEN 'large' ELSE 'standard' END AS order_segment FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number
SELECT p.id, CASE WHEN p.amount >= 250 THEN 'high' WHEN p.amount >= 100 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS payment_band FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.name, CASE WHEN p.unit_price >= 300 THEN 'premium' ELSE 'regular' END AS price_segment FROM products AS p ORDER BY p.name

SELECT c.name, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.id) >= 4 THEN 'frequent' ELSE 'occasional' END AS customer_segment FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.name
SELECT o.order_number, CASE WHEN o.discount_amount > 0 THEN 'discounted' ELSE 'full_price' END AS pricing_segment FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number
SELECT r.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count FROM regions AS r LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name
SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.name
SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS product_count FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
SELECT sr.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count FROM sales_representatives AS sr LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY sr.name
SELECT p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS order_count FROM payments AS p GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status
SELECT o.status, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status
SELECT p.status, AVG(p.amount) AS average_amount FROM payments AS p GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status
SELECT p.category, AVG(p.unit_price) AS average_price FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
SELECT r.reason, COUNT(r.id) AS refund_count FROM refunds AS r GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY r.reason
SELECT o.currency, SUM(o.subtotal) AS subtotal_total FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency
SELECT p.category, AVG(p.unit_price) AS average_price FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY average_price DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS order_total FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_total DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT sr.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT r.reason, SUM(r.amount) AS refund_total FROM refunds AS r GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY refund_total DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 2 ORDER BY c.name
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 100 ORDER BY p.category
SELECT sr.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 10 ORDER BY sr.name
SELECT p.status, COUNT(p.id) AS payment_count FROM payments AS p GROUP BY p.status HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 20 ORDER BY p.status
SELECT c.name, AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING AVG(o.total_amount) > 250 ORDER BY c.name
SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS order_total FROM regions AS r JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.id JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(pay.amount) AS payment_total FROM regions AS r JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.id JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments AS pay ON pay.order_id = o.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name

SELECT sr.name AS representative, SUM(r.amount) AS refund_total FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = o.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY sr.name
SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
SELECT o.order_number, CASE WHEN o.subtotal = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(o.discount_amount AS DECIMAL) / o.subtotal * 100 END AS discount_percent FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number
SELECT o.order_number, o.subtotal - o.total_amount AS price_difference FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number
SELECT oi.id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS extended_value FROM order_items AS oi ORDER BY oi.id
SELECT o.currency, AVG(o.discount_amount) AS average_discount FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency

SELECT o.order_number, CASE WHEN o.subtotal = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL) / o.subtotal END AS refund_fraction FROM orders AS o JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = o.id ORDER BY o.order_number
SELECT o.order_number, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT p.id, p.amount FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.amount DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT p.name, p.category FROM products AS p ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 5
SELECT r.id, r.amount FROM refunds AS r ORDER BY r.amount DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT c.name, c.region_id FROM customers AS c ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 10

SELECT p.name, p.unit_price FROM products AS p WHERE p.unit_price < (SELECT AVG(i.unit_price) FROM products AS i) ORDER BY p.unit_price
SELECT p.id, p.amount FROM payments AS p WHERE p.amount > (SELECT AVG(i.amount) FROM payments AS i) ORDER BY p.amount DESC

SELECT p.category, AVG(p.unit_price) AS average_price FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category HAVING AVG(p.unit_price) > (SELECT AVG(i.unit_price) FROM products AS i) ORDER BY p.category
